items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: when I first knew Wooden Joe, he was playing clarinet. Yeah, I remember, I heard him on clarinet too. He played both of them in his late- You heard him on clarinet? Yeah, I made a record of Wooden Joe on clarinet that time.

ctx.x: Did Jimmy Noon start on clarinet, do you think, or did he play anything else first? No, he always played clarinet. Always played clarinet. Always played clarinet. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Always played clarinet.

And you take, when I first knew Wooden Joe, he was playing clarinet. Yeah, I remember, I heard him on clarinet too. He played both of them in his late- You heard him on clarinet? Yeah, I made a record of Wooden Joe on clarinet that time. Yeah? He was playing clarinet. He played the blues, you know.

How he, from the understanding I got, how he got off of clarinet on trumpet, and he cut his fingers, cut his fingers, cut his fingers, cut his hand, and he couldn't... He could move the fingers, but he couldn't bend it.
